text.setup: Strap your feet in so the strap crosses the widest part of the foot. Set the damper around 3 to 5; a higher setting is not a harder workout.
cues: Push with the legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Return in reverse: arms, body, then knees.
Keep the handle path level.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs have pushed.
Setting the damper to 10.

text.setup: Stand facing the machine with the handles at head height, feet hip-width apart.
cues: Drive the handles down by hinging at the hips and bending the knees slightly.
Finish with hands past the hips, then rise tall to reach up again.
mistakes: Using only the arms.
Squatting deeply on every pull.

text.setup: Step on with the pedals at the lowest point and hold the moving handles.
cues: Stand tall and push and pull the handles to share the work with the arms.
Raise resistance rather than speed to make it harder.
mistakes: Leaning heavily on the static rails.

text.setup: Load the sled lightly at first. For a push, hold the uprights with arms straight and lean in at about 45 degrees.
cues: Drive with short, powerful steps through the balls of the feet.
Keep the back flat and the head neutral.
For a pull, walk backwards holding the straps with a slight squat.
mistakes: Overloading the sled so you crawl along.

text.setup: Hold one rope end in each hand, step back until there is a little slack, and stand in a quarter squat.
cues: Make alternating or double waves that travel to the anchor.
Keep the hips low and the core braced.
mistakes: Standing upright so the lower back takes the strain.

text.setup: Use a bell you can swing with crisp technique for 15 to 20 reps.
cues: Hinge, do not squat, and let the hips drive the bell.
Rest as soon as technique slips.
mistakes: Chasing reps with a rounded back.

text.setup: Pick moderate weights you can carry for 30 to 40 metres without stopping.
cues: Walk tall with short steps.
Set the weights down by squatting, then rest.
mistakes: Dropping the weights from standing.

text.setup: Use a soft medicine ball and a solid wall or open space.
cues: Move fast with full intent on each throw.
Reset between reps so each one is crisp.
mistakes: Throwing with the arms only.

text.setup: Clear a space on the floor. The app lists the moves and the work and rest times.
cues: Keep each move clean; slow down rather than lose form.
Breathe steadily through the work periods.
mistakes: Racing through reps with sloppy technique.

text.setup: Stand on the middle of the rope; the handles should reach about your armpits.
cues: Turn the rope with the wrists, not the arms.
Make small, quiet jumps on the balls of your feet.
mistakes: Jumping high and landing heavily.

text.setup: Clip on the safety key, start at an easy pace and raise the speed or incline gradually. Stand tall and keep the console within reach without leaning on it.
cues: Walk naturally with a relaxed arm swing.
On an incline, shorten your stride slightly and keep your chest up.
Let go of the handrails once you are steady; holding them takes work away from the legs.
mistakes: Leaning back on the handrails on a steep incline.
Jumping on or off a moving belt.

text.setup: Set the seat so your knee keeps a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke and your hips don't rock from side to side.
cues: Push through the whole foot and keep your knees in line with your feet.
Change effort with resistance rather than spinning ever faster.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
mistakes: A seat so low the knees come up close to the chest.
Gripping the handlebars hard and hunching.

text.setup: Set the seat as for a normal bike. The fan gets harder the faster you go, so start easy.
cues: Push and pull the handles together with the legs.
For intervals, build up over the first few seconds instead of sprinting from a standstill.
Keep your back tall.
mistakes: Starting each interval flat out and fading after a few seconds.
Shrugging the shoulders towards the ears.

text.setup: Start slowly and hold the rails lightly for balance only.
cues: Place the whole foot on each step.
Stand tall rather than folding over the console.
Choose a speed you can hold with steady breathing.
mistakes: Leaning heavily on the rails.
Taking tiny steps on the toes only.

text.setup: Clip on the safety key and warm up with a few minutes of brisk walking before raising the speed.
cues: Land softly with your foot under your body.
Keep a quick, light step.
Relax your shoulders and hands.
mistakes: Overstriding and landing hard on the heel.
Running at a pace you can't hold steadily.
